description: Source code for a Linux kernel driver implementing a Real Time Clock (RTC) for WL-HDD devices, including I2C communication, platform detection, and device registration.

methods.name: rtc_open
methods.description: Opens the RTC device, initializes I2C, and manages device lock.

methods.name: rtc_read
methods.description: Reads current RTC time and outputs in specified format.

methods.name: rtc_write
methods.description: Sets RTC time based on input string in specific format.

methods.name: rtc_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for reading and setting RTC time.

methods.name: get_rtc_time
methods.description: Reads time from RTC hardware via I2C.

methods.name: set_rtc_time
methods.description: Writes time to RTC hardware via I2C.

methods.name: platform_detect
methods.description: Detects hardware platform to set GPIO indices.

methods.name: rtc_init
methods.description: Initializes the RTC driver, detects platform, switches to 24h mode, registers device.

methods.name: rtc_exit
methods.description: Cleans up and deregisters the RTC device.
